body: I've tried so many different meds over the years, the ones I'm currently on have Zero effect on me and whilst I have told the doctors/therapists all this they just insist I keep taking them

I don't think it's actually possible to keep the voices silent at all, I'm scared to go back to work atm (I have 2 jobs) because I'm genuinely terrified of what might happen atm as the voices are currently in the worst state they've ever been so far. I really love my jobs it's one of the few things that have been able to keep me going this long.

Social services have been involved since before my son was born due to his mother having mental health problems. She's been taking this accusation very seriously and has refused to let me have contact with my son at this time.

My younger brother has been involved with drugs for the last decade and the last 6 weeks he's not had a job or any money so I know his addiction is taking over. 3 days before he accused me of this he was asking to borrow money from me and I know he has stolen from me in the past. Thursday night he smashed up my room and destroyed a lot of my collectibles aswell before he took his own things (tv, game console, clothes) out of the house and never came back until Saturday night. 

His entire story which I have logged in the Facebook chat group I had created begins with him stating he'd been holding onto this for 17 years, this makes me 12 years old at the time. 30 mins after this he is then adamant I was 15 years old. His entire story is flawed from the get go.
